_comment: Example of ~/.claude/ngvu-factory/machine.json. deploy/bootstrap writes it from -Team and -Workspace; it stays on your machine, never in this repo. Optional keys: serviceCatalog (path to a Markdown service catalog); personalRoots (folders of your own repos where the guard lets you push any non-protected branch, e.g. ["D:/Personal"]; leave it out on a work-only machine); unitTest.<kind> (default java-service: mvn clean install -DskipITs=true -B; a .bat path runs through cmd); reportLanguage (language of investigation reports, default en). The reportLanguage and unitTest values below are examples only; leave them out to use the defaults.
